board.current_board: Ol i mekim wok long en nau: {board}

player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id} na yu plei game bilong Checkers olsem {color}.
Mekim yu move long notation bilong chess [fileRank fileRank], olsem '[b2c3]' (leta bilong kolom a–h, digit bilong lain 0–7).
Rul bilong bipo:
  • Go pas long diagonali go forwet wanpela step sapos emi no gat samting.
  • Kapsaitim pes bilong birua long jumpim ova.
  • Wanpela pes i kamap King sapos emi kisim arapela end.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nogat fomat muv bilong yu. Usim [a1b2], olsem [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Ol retpela i no gat moa pilai, na blak win!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Ol blak i no gat moa pilai, na ret em i win!
outcome.no_moves: Man {player_id} i no gat narapela hap bilong em long mekim.
outcome.draw: Mipela i kamap pinis long mak bilong tanim.
